title: carex regelii
intro: Carex regelii, commonly known as Regel's sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex regelii include its use in traditional medicine to treat colds, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Carex regelii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
